25.00% | 2,500 |\n| 中证500指数基金 | EQ_000905 | 15.00% | 1,500 |\n| 创业板指数基金 | EQ_399006 | 10.00% | 1,000 |\n| 中长期国债组合 | CGB | 20.00% | 2,000 |\n| 美元现金及存款 | USD_CASH | 10.00% | 1,000 |\n| 标普500 QDII基金 | SPX | 10.00% | 1,000 |\n| 人民币现金及货基 | CNY_CASH | 10.00% | 1,000 |\n\n核验：\n\n- 权重合计：1.00\n- 市值合计：10,000 万元\n- 每项满足 `权重 × 10,000 = 市值`\n- 境内权益合计：50%\n- 外币敞口：20%\n- CNY 现金：10%\n- 国债：20%\n\n## 4.2 推荐组合：`/app/input_files/params_holdings.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nasset,asset_class,weight_current,weight_recommended\n```\n\n| 类别 | 当前 | 推荐 | 权重变化 | 交易金额，万元 |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n| EQ_000300 | 25.00% | 14.75% | -10.25pp | 卖出 1,025 |\n| EQ_000905 | 15.00% | 8.85% | -6.15pp | 卖出 615 |\n| EQ_399006 | 10.00% | 5.90% | -4.10pp | 卖出 410 |\n| CGB | 20.00% | 30.50% | +10.50pp | 买入 1,050 |\n| USD_CASH | 10.00% | 10.00% | 0 | 0 |\n| SPX | 10.00% | 10.00% | 0 | 0 |\n| CNY_CASH | 10.00% | 20.00% | +10.00pp | 留存现金 1,000 |\n\n核验：\n\n- 推荐权重合计：1.0000\n- 总卖出：20.50%，即 2,050 万元\n- 总买入/留存：20.50%，即 2,050 万元\n- 单向换手率：20.50%\n- 三项境内权益都乘以 `0.59`：\n  - `25% × 0.59 = 14.75%`\n  - `15% × 0.59 = 8.85%`\n  - `10% × 0.59 = 5.90%`\n\n## 4.3 国债久期参数：`/app/input_files/params_duration.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\ntenor,duration_contribution\n```\n\n| 期限 | 久期贡献 |\n|---|---:|\n| 1年 | 0.1 |\n| 2年 | 0.3 |\n| 5年 | 1.2 |\n| 10年 | 3.6 |\n| 30年 | 1.8 |\n\n合计久期贡献：**7.0**。\n\n可直接采用的一阶国债组合收益近似为：\n\n```text\nr_CGB = -Σ(duration_contribution_i × Δyield_i)\n```\n\n其中 `Δyield_i` 必须是十进制。例如输入 `+0.10` 表示 `+0.10个百分点 = +10bp = 0.001`。\n\n## 4.4 九项限额：`/app/input_files/params_limits.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nid,constraint,op,lower,upper,unit,note\n```\n\n| ID | 约束 | 操作 | 下限 | 上限 | 直接编码条件 |\n|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|\n| L1 | 权重合计 | `=` | 1.0 | 1.0 | `abs(sum(w)-1) <= 0.0005` |\n| L2 | 境内权益合计 | `<=` | — | 0.60 | `w300+w500+w399006 <= 0.60` |\n| L3 | 人民币现金及货基 | `in` | 0.08 | 0.20 | `0.08 <= w_cny <= 0.20` |\n| L4 | 中长期国债组合 | `>=` | — | 0.15 | `w_cgb >= 0.15` |\n| L5 | 外币资产敞口 | `<=` | — | 0.25 | `w_usd_cash+w_spx <= 0.25` |\n| L6 | 1日 ES99 | `<=` | — | 0.035 | `ES99_1d <= 3.5%` |\n| L7 | 10日 VaR99 | `<=` | — | 0.060 | `VaR99_10d <= 6.0%` |\n| L8 | 最大压力损失 | `<=` | — | 0.080 | 32格压力结果最大损失 ≤8% |\n| L9 | 最大压力损失缓冲线 | `<=` | — | 0.070 | 推荐方案必须 ≤7% |\n\n注意：\n\n- L1–L5 的数值实际使用**小数权重**，虽然 `unit` 写成 `%`。\n- L8 和 L9 测量同一指标，只是阈值不同。\n- L9 是在 L8 的基础上额外留出 1 个百分点缓冲。\n- `/app/input_files/rules_checks.csv` 明确赋予 L1 **0.05 个百分点容差**，即十进制 `0.0005`。\n\n## 4.5 委员会冲击：`/app/input_files/params_committee_shocks.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nscenario_id,scenario,cn_equity_shock,spx_usd_shock,\nusdcnh_shock,cgb_shock_bp\n```\n\n| 情景 | 境内权益 | SPX美元 | USD/CNH | 1Y | 2Y | 5Y | 10Y | 30Y |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n| S1 增长下行与政策宽松 | -12% | -8% | +2% | +0.10pp | +0.12pp | +0.10pp | +0.20pp | +0.25pp |\n| S2 通胀上行与利率上行 | -10% | -6% | +3% | +0.60pp | +0.50pp | +0.30pp | -0.15pp | -0.30pp |\n| S3 外部冲击与美元走强 | -15% | -18% | +8% | -0.30pp | -0.25pp | -0.10pp | +0.10pp | +0.20pp |\n| S4 信用收缩与资金面收紧 | -18% | -12% | +5% | +0.80pp | +0.60pp | +0.45pp | -0.45pp | -0.50pp |\n\n按上述单位和久期公式得到的国债组合冲击：\n\n| 情景 | 国债组合收益 |\n|---|---:|\n| S1 | -1.336% |\n| S2 | +0.510% |\n| S3 | -0.495% |\n| S4 | +1.720% |\n\n人民币计价 SPX 冲击必须包含乘法交互项：\n\n```text\nr_SPX_CNY = (1 + r_SPX_USD) × (1 + r_USDCNH) - 1\n```\n\n结果：\n\n| 情景 | SPX人民币冲击 |\n|---|---:|\n| S1 | -6.160% |\n| S2 | -3.180% |\n| S3 | -11.440% |\n| S4 | -7.600% |\n\n---\n\n# 5. 情景与历史样本规则\n\n## 5.1 月度情景识别：`/app/input_files/rules_scenarios.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nscenario_id,scenario,rule,tag,shock_type\n```\n\n### S1 增长下行与政策宽松\n\n标签：`growth_slowdown`  \n冲击类型：`宽松`\n\n逻辑应解析为：\n\n```text\n(PMI < 50 AND (LPR_1Y当月下调 OR LPR_5Y当月下调))\nOR\n(PMI较上月下行 >= 0.5 AND 10Y中债月均值 < 上月月均值)\n```\n\n### S2 通胀上行与利率上行\n\n标签：`inflation_up`  \n冲击类型：`紧缩`\n\n```text\nPPI同比 > 上月\nAND 10Y中债月均值 > 上月月均值\nAND 权益指数当月收益 < 0\n```\n\n### S3 外部冲击与美元走强\n\n标签：`external_shock`  \n冲击类型：`美元升值`\n\n```text\nSPX当月收益 <= -3%\nOR USD/CNH当月变化 >= +1.5%\n```\n\n### S4 信用收缩与资金面收紧\n\n标签：`credit_tightening`  \n冲击类型：`资金紧`\n\n```text\n社融存量同比增速 < 上月\nAND DR007月均值 > 上月月均值\nAND 权益指数当月收益 < 0\n```\n\n### 尚未定义但编码必须决定的事项\n\n- S2/S4 的“权益指数”没有说明是：\n  - 沪深300\n  - 三项境内权益等权\n  - 当前持仓加权组合\n  - 各方案加权组合\n- 月收益采用月末对上月末还是月内首末交易日。\n- 中债和 DR007 月均值是否先筛选上交所交易日。\n- PMI `2026-08` 缺失时，`2026-09` 是否标记“不足数据”，而不是直接与 7 月比较。\n- LPR 下调应使用每月最后有效值比较，不宜对日频/政策发布混合序列求月均值。\n\n## 5.2 历史窗口规则：`/app/input_files/rules_windows.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nkey,value\n```\n\n确切规则：\n\n1. `window_start`\n   - 情景合格月份的**次月第一个上交所交易日**\n\n2. `window_length`\n   - **10 个上交所交易日**\n\n3. `window_rule`\n   - 用对应方案权重按日再平衡\n   - 计算完整 10 日窗口累计组合收益\n   - 只有累计收益为负的窗口才合格\n   - 不要求窗口内每一天都为负\n   - 合格窗口按累计跌幅从大到小排序\n   - 全部合格窗口用于校准\n   - 不设合格窗口数量下限\n   - 没有合格窗口时不得回退到未筛选窗口，也不得伪报窗口数\n\n4. `calibration`\n   - 对全部合格窗口中，各风险因子的 10 日累计变动取**中位数**\n   - 某情景没有合格窗口时，该情景历史校准冲击按 **0** 计\n   - 必须在结论中说明无历史校准窗口\n\n### 编码含义\n\n10 日组合累计收益应按每日再平衡解释为：\n\n```text\nR_window = Π_t(1 + Σ_i w_i r_i,t) - 1\n```\n\n而不是用窗口首末资产收益后再一次性按权重相加。\n\n需要注意：由于“按方案权重”筛选负收益窗口，不同方案可能得到不同的合格窗口集合，因此历史校准冲击原则上也可能是**方案相关**的。文件没有明确说明校准冲击是否应统一使用当前组合筛选，必须在实现说明中固定。\n\n---\n\n# 6. 调仓执行规则\n\n来源：`/app/input_files/rules_rebalance.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nkey,value\n```\n\n确切规则：\n\n| 键 | 值 |\n|---|---|\n| execution_order | 先卖出后买入；卖出资金当日可用，买入国债当日扣款 |\n| cash_floor | 执行全程人民币现金及货基不得低于 8% |\n| qdii_settlement | SPX QDII赎回款T+7到账，赎回当日不增加可用现金 |\n| turnover | 单向换手率 = 卖出金额合计 / 组合净值 |\n| trade_unit | 万元，保留两位小数 |\n| price_basis | 2026-09-15收盘价/估值日价格 |\n| recommendation_rule | USD现金和SPX各保持10%；境内三项权益按0.59同比缩减；减配20.5pp，其中10.5pp转国债、10pp转人民币现金 |\n\n## 6.1 推荐方案现金路径\n\n### 正确路径：先卖后买\n\n1. 初始 CNY 现金：10.00%\n2. 卖出三项境内权益 20.50%：\n   - 现金变为 30.50%\n3. 买入国债 10.50%：\n   - 现金变为 20.00%\n4. 最低现金占比：10.00%\n5. 全程高于 8% 下限\n\n### 错误路径：先买后卖\n\n1. 初始 CNY 现金：10.00%\n2. 先买国债 10.50%：\n   - 现金变为 **-0.50%**\n3. 已击穿 8% 下限，超限 8.50 个百分点\n4. 随后卖出权益虽可恢复至 20%，但不能消除执行过程违规\n\n推荐方案不交易 SPX，因此 T+7 结算规则不影响本次推荐执行。\n\n---\n\n# 7. 候选方案及静态约束\n\n来源：`/app/input_files/plans_candidates.csv`\n\n| 方案 | 提议方 | 300 | 500 | 创业板 | CGB | USD现金 | SPX | CNY现金 |\n|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n| A | CGB | 外币敞口 | 单向换手 |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n| 当前 | 100% | 50% | 10% | 20% | 20% | 0% |\n| A | 100% | 55% | 10% | 15% | 20% | 6% |\n| B | 100% | 40% | 15% | 25% | 20% | 10% |\n| C | 100% | 40% | 12% | 18% | **30%** | 12% |\n| 推荐 | 100% | 29.50% | 20% | 30.50% | 20% | 20.50% |\n\n结论：\n\n- 当前、A、B、推荐方案通过 L1–L5。\n- C 方案违反 L5：\n  - 实际外币敞口 30%\n  - 上限 25%\n  - 超限 5 个百分点\n- SPX 必须计入外币敞口；漏计 SPX 时会错误地把 C 的外币敞口算成 20%。\n\n## 7.1 委员会冲击诊断结果\n\n按前述标准压力公式计算：\n\n| 组合 | S1损失 | S2损失 | S3损失 | S4损失 | 最大损失 | L8 8% | L9 7% |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|\n| 当前 | 6.6832% | 4.9160% | 7.9430% | `2026-09-01`\n   - 因而 2026 年 9 月的“较上月变化”无法按严格日历月定义计算。\n\n5. **1 年期 LPR 缺少 `2024-11` 记录**\n   - `2024-10-21 = 3.10`\n   - 下一条为 `2024-12-20 = 3.10`\n   - 若按月度政策利率序列使用，需要明确是否前向填充 `2024-11 = 3.10`。\n\n6. **`snapshot_ust_m2.csv` 与 `snapshot_ust_m4.csv` 在 6 个日期完全重叠，但值均不同**\n   - `m4` 不是 `m2` 的无缝后续段，应视为另一版本或修订片段。\n   - 在确认数据语义前，不能直接拼接或用其中之一覆盖另一个。\n\n7. **压力测试计算单位存在命名歧义**\n   - `/app/input_files/params_committee_shocks.csv` 的列名为 `cgb_shock_bp`，但值写成 `+0.10`、`+0.60` 等。\n   - 从候选方案的预期通过/失败结构反推，正确口径应当是：\n     - `+0.10` 表示收益率上升 **0.10 个百分点，即 +10bp**\n     - 不是字面意义上的 `+0.10bp`\n   - 建议解析后将其转换为十进制收益率变化：`0.10 / 100 = 0.001`。\n\n8. **历史 VaR/ES、月度权益指标和海外价格对齐规则未被完整定义**\n   - 简单收益还是对数收益\n   - VaR 分位数插值方法\n   - ES 的尾部定义\n   - 10 日收益是否采用重叠窗口\n   - “权益指数当月下跌”具体指哪个指数或哪个组合\n   - 海外休市日如何映射到上交所交易日  \n   这些均需在实现时显式固定，否则结果不可唯一复算。\n\n---\n\n# 2. 实际文件清单\n\n## 2.1 模板\n\n- `/app/input_files/template_memo.md`\n- `/app/input_files/template_monitor.csv`\n\n## 2.2 参数文件\n\n- 当前组合风险画像\n4. 情景识别与历史校准\n5. 压力测试结果\n6. 候选方案评估与九项约束检查\n7. 推荐方案与调仓执行\n8. 反向压力测试与监测预警\n\n全局格式要求：\n\n- 组合净值：**10,000 万元**\n- 金额单位：万元\n- 百分比：保留两位小数\n- 收益率变动：保留两位小数并注明 `bp` 或 `%`\n- 所有结论必须能追溯到输入快照或可复算过程\n\n正文必须包含的核心输出包括：\n\n- 推荐方案最大压力损失、1 日 ES99、10 日 VaR99、单向换手率\n- 全部序列覆盖区间、缺失期次、截断标记、结构性空值\n- 休市日异常记录和剔除结果\n- 汇率及海外价格对齐方法\n- 日收益统计、相关矩阵、年化波动率\n- 1 日 VaR95/99、ES95/99、10 日 VaR99\n- 10 日最大累计损失、最大回撤、修复日、最差单日\n- 风险贡献\n- 四个情景的合格月份、历史窗口和冲击中位数\n- 四方案 × 四情景 × 两套冲击的 32 个压力结果\n- 每个压力结果拆为：\n  - 境内权益\n  - 标普500人民币计价\n  - 美元现金\n  - 国债\n- 九项检查及超限幅度\n- 调仓交易清单和现金路径\n- 反向压力测试、马氏距离\n- 八项监测指标\n\n附件要求：\n\n- 至少 10 张 PNG\n- 复算脚本应从输入快照读取，不得硬编码结果\n\n## 3.2 `/app/input_files/template_monitor.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nmonitor_id,indicator,definition,threshold,direction,\nlatest_value,data_asof,status,triggered\n```\n\n共有 8 项；后四个输出字段目前全部为空：\n\n| ID | 指标 | 阈值 | 触发方向 | 实现口径 |\n|---|---|---:|---|---|\n| M1 | 沪深300 20日收益 | -5.00% | 低于 | 最近20个上交所交易日累计收益 |\n| M2 | USD/CNH 20日变化 | +2.00% | 高于 | 最近20个上交所交易日累计变动率 |\n| M3 | DR007资金面变化 | +20.00bp | 高于 | 最近20日均值减此前60日均值 |\n| M4 | 10年期国债收益率20日变化 | +10.00bp | 高于 | 10年中债收益率端点变化 |\n| M5 | 美国10年期国债收益率20日变化 | +40.00bp | 高于 | 美国10年收益率端点变化 |\n| M6 | PPI同比加速 | +1.50个百分点 | 高于 | 最新同比减3个月前同比 |\n| M7 | 制造业PMI荣枯线 | 49.00 | 低于 | 最新月值 |\n| M8 | 社融存量增速 | 8.00% | 低于 | 由社融存量计算最新同比 |\n\n编码注意：\n\n- M1/M2“20日”通常需要 21 个价格水平计算 20 段收益。\n- M3 的 `+20bp` 应实现为：\n  `mean(last 20) - mean(previous 60) >= 0.20`，因为源数据单位是百分数。\n- M8 源文件是社融**存量水平**，不是同比增速；应计算：\n  `afre_stock[t] / afre_stock[t-12] - 1`。\n- M2 必须先决定 USD/CNH 在上交所休市/境外休市差异下的对齐规则。\n\n---\n\n# 4. 参数文件\n\n## 4.1 当前组合：`/app/input_files/params_positions.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nasset,asset_class,weight_current,market_value_10k_cny\n```\n\n| 资产 | 类别 | 当前权重 | 市值，万元 |\n|---|---|---:|---:|\n| 沪深300指数基金 | EQ_000300 | 25.00% | 2,500 |\n| 中证500指数基金 | EQ_000905 | 15.00% | 1,500 |\n| 创业板指数基金 | EQ_399006 | 10.00% | 1,000 |\n| 中长期国债组合 | CGB | 20.00% | 2,000 |\n| 美元现金及存款 | USD_CASH | 10.00% | 1,000 |\n| 标普500 QDII基金 | SPX | 10.00% | 1,000 |\n| 人民币现金及货基 | CNY_CASH | 10.00% | 1,000 |\n\n核验：\n\n- 权重合计：1.00\n- 市值合计：10,000 万元\n- 每项满足 `权重 × 10,000 = 市值`\n- 境内权益合计：50%\n- 外币敞口：20%\n- CNY 现金：10%\n- 国债：20%\n\n## 4.2 推荐组合：`/app/input_files/params_holdings.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nasset,asset_class,weight_current,weight_recommended\n```\n\n| 类别 | 当前 | 推荐 | 权重变化 | 交易金额，万元 |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n| EQ_000300 | 25.00% | 14.75% | -10.25pp | 卖出 1,025 |\n| EQ_000905 | 15.00% | 8.85% | -6.15pp | 卖出 615 |\n| EQ_399006 | 10.00% | 5.90% | -4.10pp | 卖出 410 |\n| CGB | 20.00% | 30.50% | +10.50pp | 买入 1,050 |\n| USD_CASH | 10.00% | 10.00% | 0 | 0 |\n| SPX | 10.00% | 10.00% | 0 | 0 |\n| CNY_CASH | 10.00% | 20.00% | +10.00pp | 留存现金 1,000 |\n\n核验：\n\n- 推荐权重合计：1.0000\n- 总卖出：20.50%，即 2,050 万元\n- 总买入/留存：20.50%，即 2,050 万元\n- 单向换手率：20.50%\n- 三项境内权益都乘以 `0.59`：\n  - `25% × 0.59 = 14.75%`\n  - `15% × 0.59 = 8.85%`\n  - `10% × 0.59 = 5.90%`\n\n## 4.3 国债久期参数：`/app/input_files/params_duration.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\ntenor,duration_contribution\n```\n\n| 期限 | 久期贡献 |\n|---|---:|\n| 1年 | 0.1 |\n| 2年 | 0.3 |\n| 5年 | 1.2 |\n| 10年 | 3.6 |\n| 30年 | 1.8 |\n\n合计久期贡献：**7.0**。\n\n可直接采用的一阶国债组合收益近似为：\n\n```text\nr_CGB = -Σ(duration_contribution_i × Δyield_i)\n```\n\n其中 `Δyield_i` 必须是十进制。例如输入 `+0.10` 表示 `+0.10个百分点 = +10bp = 0.001`。\n\n## 4.4 九项限额：`/app/input_files/params_limits.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nid,constraint,op,lower,upper,unit,note\n```\n\n| ID | 约束 | 操作 | 下限 | 上限 | 直接编码条件 |\n|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|\n| L1 | 权重合计 | `=` | 1.0 | 1.0 | `abs(sum(w)-1) <= 0.0005` |\n| L2 | 境内权益合计 | `<=` | — | 0.60 | `w300+w500+w399006 <= 0.60` |\n| L3 | 人民币现金及货基 | `in` | 0.08 | 0.20 | `0.08 <= w_cny <= 0.20` |\n| L4 | 中长期国债组合 | `>=` | — | 0.15 | `w_cgb >= 0.15` |\n| L5 | 外币资产敞口 | `<=` | — | 0.25 | `w_usd_cash+w_spx <= 0.25` |\n| L6 | 1日 ES99 | `<=` | — | 0.035 | `ES99_1d <= 3.5%` |\n| L7 | 10日 VaR99 | `<=` | — | 0.060 | `VaR99_10d <= 6.0%` |\n| L8 | 最大压力损失 | `<=` | — | 0.080 | 32格压力结果最大损失 ≤8% |\n| L9 | 最大压力损失缓冲线 | `<=` | — | 0.070 | 推荐方案必须 ≤7% |\n\n注意：\n\n- L1–L5 的数值实际使用**小数权重**，虽然 `unit` 写成 `%`。\n- L8 和 L9 测量同一指标，只是阈值不同。\n- L9 是在 L8 的基础上额外留出 1 个百分点缓冲。\n- `/app/input_files/rules_checks.csv` 明确赋予 L1 **0.05 个百分点容差**，即十进制 `0.0005`。\n\n## 4.5 委员会冲击：`/app/input_files/params_committee_shocks.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nscenario_id,scenario,cn_equity_shock,spx_usd_shock,\nusdcnh_shock,cgb_shock_bp\n```\n\n| 情景 | 境内权益 | SPX美元 | USD/CNH | 1Y | 2Y | 5Y | 10Y | 30Y |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n| S1 增长下行与政策宽松 | -12% | -8% | +2% | +0.10pp | +0.12pp | +0.10pp | +0.20pp | +0.25pp |\n| S2 通胀上行与利率上行 | -10% | -6% | +3% | +0.60pp | +0.50pp | +0.30pp | -0.15pp | -0.30pp |\n| S3 外部冲击与美元走强 | -15% | -18% | +8% | -0.30pp | -0.25pp | -0.10pp | +0.10pp | +0.20pp |\n| S4 信用收缩与资金面收紧 | -18% | -12% | +5% | +0.80pp | +0.60pp | +0.45pp | -0.45pp | -0.50pp |\n\n按上述单位和久期公式得到的国债组合冲击：\n\n| 情景 | 国债组合收益 |\n|---|---:|\n| S1 | -1.336% |\n| S2 | +0.510% |\n| S3 | -0.495% |\n| S4 | +1.720% |\n\n人民币计价 SPX 冲击必须包含乘法交互项：\n\n```text\nr_SPX_CNY = (1 + r_SPX_USD) × (1 + r_USDCNH) - 1\n```\n\n结果：\n\n| 情景 | SPX人民币冲击 |\n|---|---:|\n| S1 | -6.160% |\n| S2 | -3.180% |\n| S3 | -11.440% |\n| S4 | -7.600% |\n\n---\n\n# 5. 情景与历史样本规则\n\n## 5.1 月度情景识别：`/app/input_files/rules_scenarios.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nscenario_id,scenario,rule,tag,shock_type\n```\n\n### S1 增长下行与政策宽松\n\n标签：`growth_slowdown`  \n冲击类型：`宽松`\n\n逻辑应解析为：\n\n```text\n(PMI < 50 AND (LPR_1Y当月下调 OR LPR_5Y当月下调))\nOR\n(PMI较上月下行 >= 0.5 AND 10Y中债月均值 < 上月月均值)\n```\n\n### S2 通胀上行与利率上行\n\n标签：`inflation_up`  \n冲击类型：`紧缩`\n\n```text\nPPI同比 > 上月\nAND 10Y中债月均值 > 上月月均值\nAND 权益指数当月收益 < 0\n```\n\n### S3 外部冲击与美元走强\n\n标签：`external_shock`  \n冲击类型：`美元升值`\n\n```text\nSPX当月收益 <= -3%\nOR USD/CNH当月变化 >= +1.5%\n```\n\n### S4 信用收缩与资金面收紧\n\n标签：`credit_tightening`  \n冲击类型：`资金紧`\n\n```text\n社融存量同比增速 < 上月\nAND DR007月均值 > 上月月均值\nAND 权益指数当月收益 < 0\n```\n\n### 尚未定义但编码必须决定的事项\n\n- S2/S4 的“权益指数”没有说明是：\n  - 沪深300\n  - 三项境内权益等权\n  - 当前持仓加权组合\n  - 各方案加权组合\n- 月收益采用月末对上月末还是月内首末交易日。\n- 中债和 DR007 月均值是否先筛选上交所交易日。\n- PMI `2026-08` 缺失时，`2026-09` 是否标记“不足数据”，而不是直接与 7 月比较。\n- LPR 下调应使用每月最后有效值比较，不宜对日频/政策发布混合序列求月均值。\n\n## 5.2 历史窗口规则：`/app/input_files/rules_windows.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nkey,value\n```\n\n确切规则：\n\n1. `window_start`\n   - 情景合格月份的**次月第一个上交所交易日**\n\n2. `window_length`\n   - **10 个上交所交易日**\n\n3. `window_rule`\n   - 用对应方案权重按日再平衡\n   - 计算完整 10 日窗口累计组合收益\n   - 只有累计收益为负的窗口才合格\n   - 不要求窗口内每一天都为负\n   - 合格窗口按累计跌幅从大到小排序\n   - 全部合格窗口用于校准\n   - 不设合格窗口数量下限\n   - 没有合格窗口时不得回退到未筛选窗口，也不得伪报窗口数\n\n4. `calibration`\n   - 对全部合格窗口中，各风险因子的 10 日累计变动取**中位数**\n   - 某情景没有合格窗口时，该情景历史校准冲击按 **0** 计\n   - 必须在结论中说明无历史校准窗口\n\n### 编码含义\n\n10 日组合累计收益应按每日再平衡解释为：\n\n```text\nR_window = Π_t(1 + Σ_i w_i r_i,t) - 1\n```\n\n而不是用窗口首末资产收益后再一次性按权重相加。\n\n需要注意：由于“按方案权重”筛选负收益窗口，不同方案可能得到不同的合格窗口集合，因此历史校准冲击原则上也可能是**方案相关**的。文件没有明确说明校准冲击是否应统一使用当前组合筛选，必须在实现说明中固定。\n\n---\n\n# 6. 调仓执行规则\n\n来源：`/app/input_files/rules_rebalance.csv`\n\n字段：\n\n```text\nkey,value\n```\n\n确切规则：\n\n| 键 | 值 |\n|---|---|\n| execution_order | 先卖出后买入；卖出资金当日可用，买入国债当日扣款 |\n| cash_floor | 执行全程人民币现金及货基不得低于 8% |\n| qdii_settlement | SPX QDII赎回款T+7到账，赎回当日不增加可用现金 |\n| turnover | 单向换手率 = 卖出金额合计 / 组合净值 |\n| trade_unit | 万元，保留两位小数 |\n| price_basis | 2026-09-15收盘价/估值日价格 |\n| recommendation_rule | USD现金和SPX各保持10%；境内三项权益按0.59同比缩减；减配20.5pp，其中10.5pp转国债、10pp转人民币现金 |\n\n## 6.1 推荐方案现金路径\n\n### 正确路径：先卖后买\n\n1. 初始 CNY 现金：10.00%\n2. 卖出三项境内权益 20.50%：\n   - 现金变为 30.50%\n3. 买入国债 10.50%：\n   - 现金变为 20.00%\n4. 最低现金占比：10.00%\n5. 全程高于 8% 下限\n\n### 错误路径：先买后卖\n\n1. 初始 CNY 现金：10.00%\n2. 先买国债 10.50%：\n   - 现金变为 **-0.50%**\n3. 已击穿 8% 下限，超限 8.50 个百分点\n4. 随后卖出权益虽可恢复至 20%，但不能消除执行过程违规\n\n推荐方案不交易 SPX，因此 T+7 结算规则不影响本次推荐执行。\n\n---\n\n# 7. 候选方案及静态约束\n\n来源：`/app/input_files/plans_candidates.csv`\n\n| 方案 | 提议方 | 300 | 500 | 创业板 | CGB | USD现金 | SPX | CNY现金 |\n|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n| A | 中间仅有周末及元旦休市\n- 分段间没有重复日期\n- 相邻段 `pre_close` 能正确承接前段最后 `close`\n\n合并后：\n\n- 创业板：2113 条，与上交所日历完全一致\n- 沪深300、中证500：各 2114 条，比日历多 1 条，即 `2026-09-12`\n\n异常行：\n\n```text\n沪深300 2026-09-12:\nopen=high=low=close=pre_close=4510.1554\namount=328810343\n\n中证500 2026-09-12:\nopen=high=low=close=pre_close=7580.5371\namount=149635548\n```\n\n异常依据：\n\n- 星期六\n- 不在 `/app/input_files/snapshot_trade_calendar.csv`\n- 创业板没有对应日期\n- OHLC 全部相等\n- 与前后交易日衔接存在四位/三位小数差异\n\n处理建议：以 SSE 日历为准，明确剔除这两行。\n\n## 9.2 SHIBOR 与 DR007\n\n分段边界：\n\n- SHIBOR seg1：截至 `2022-09-08`\n- SHIBOR seg2：始于 `2022-09-09`\n- 无重叠、无中间日期缺口\n\n重大一致性发现：\n\n- 合并后的 `shibor_1w` 与 `/app/input_files/snapshot_dr007.csv`：\n  - 日期集合完全相同\n  - 2000 个数值逐条完全相同\n\n这可能是有意复用，也可能是源字段误标。业务上 SHIBOR 1W 与 DR007 并非同一指标，建议在正式计算前确认数据来源。\n\n相对 SSE 日历的额外日期：\n\n- SHIBOR seg1：24 个\n- SHIBOR seg2：27 个\n- DR007：51 个\n\n这些多为银行间市场补班日或上交所休市日，不应简单认定为错误；但凡规则写明“上交所交易日”，应通过 SSE 日历过滤。\n\n## 9.3 中债收益率\n\n五条曲线日期集合完全一致：\n\n- 每条 2106 行\n- `2018-01-02` 至 `2026-06-09`\n- 覆盖区间内未缺少任何 SSE 交易日\n- 但各自有 62 个日期不在 SSE 日历中，主要为银行间市场周末补班日/假日工作日\n\n实现建议：\n\n- 月均值若按中债市场自身日期，应保留这些记录。\n- 历史组合按上交所日频计算时，应筛选为 SSE 交易日。\n- 不要把全部 62 个日期都称为错误数据。\n\n## 9.4 USD/CNH\n\n分段：\n\n- seg1：`2018-01-02` 至 `2022-09-16`\n- seg2：`2022-09-19` 至 `2026-09-15`\n- 无重叠\n- 中间仅周末 `2022-09-17`、`2022-09-18`\n\n相对 SSE 日历：\n\n- seg1 覆盖期内缺 48 个 SSE 日\n- seg2 覆盖期内缺 38 个 SSE 日\n- 多出于 SSE 日历的日期分别为 79 和 68 个\n\n这反映境外/离岸市场与境内交易日历差异，不是简单缺行。必须定义价格对齐：\n\n推荐口径是以 SSE 日历为主，取截至该 SSE 日期可得的最后一个 USD/CNH 收盘值，禁止使用未来值回填。\n\n## 9.5 SPX 与美国国债\n\n相对 SSE 日历：\n\n| 序列 | 覆盖期内缺少SSE日期 | SSE之外日期 |\n|---|---:|---:|\n| SPX | 73 | 147 |\n| UST 10Y | 84 | 147 |\n| UST m2 | 78 | 132 |\n| UST m4 | 0 | 0 |\n\n这主要是中美交易日历不一致导致。人民币计价 SPX 日收益应先分别把 SPX 与 USD/CNH 映射至 SSE 日历，再计算：\n\n```text\nr_spx_cny,t = (1+r_spx_usd,t)(1+r_fx,t)-1\n```\n\n不能对两个原始序列直接按行号拼接。\n\n## 9.6 UST m2/m4 重叠冲突\n\n六个重叠日期：\n\n| 日期 | m2 | m4 | m4-m2 |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|\n| 2026-09-08 | 4.39 | 4.51 | +0.12 |\n| 2026-09-09 | 4.43 | 4.55 | +0.12 |\n| 2026-09-10 | 4.56 | 4.6867 | +0.1267 |\n| 2026-09-11 | 4.63 | 4.73 | +0.10 |\n| 2026-09-14 | 4.65 | 4.75 | +0.10 |\n| 2026-09-15 | 4.67 | 4.7767 | +0.1067 |\n\n结论：\n\n- 不能按“seg1/seg2”逻辑拼接。\n- `m2`、`m4` 名称含义未在规则中说明。\n- 若用于补丁或修订，应由业务规则指定覆盖优先级。\n- 监测 M5 明确使用 `/app/input_files/snapshot_ust_10y.csv`，因此 m2/m4 不应擅自替换 10Y 序列。\n\n---\n\n# 10. 原始国内权益样本\n\n剔除两条 `2026-09-12` 异常记录后：\n\n- 起点：`2018-01-02`\n- 终点：`2026-09-15`\n- 上交所交易日：2113 个\n- 三个境内指数均完整覆盖\n\n## 11.2 包含国债曲线的共同样本\n\n由于五条中债曲线均止于 `2026-06-09`：\n\n- 可用于完整国债风险因子分析的终点：`2026-06-09`\n- `2018-01-02` 至 `2026-06-09` 共 2044 个 SSE 交易日\n- 后续 `2026-06-10` 至 `2026-09-15` 有 69 个 SSE 交易日缺少国债曲线数据\n\n若所有风险因子只做“同日内连接”，则：\n\n- 共同价格日期：1950 个\n- 区间：`2018-01-02` 至 `2026-06-09`\n- 可形成 1949 个一日收益\n\n但这种方法会因美国休市日丢弃大量中国交易日。\n\n更合适的编码策略是：\n\n1. 以 SSE 日历为主轴；\n2. 境内权益直接按日历连接；\n3. 中债曲线仅保留 SSE 日期；\n4. SPX、USD/CNH、UST 使用“截至当日最后可用值”前向对齐；\n5. 禁止向后取未来值；\n6. 则可保留 2044 个价格日、形成 2043 个一日收益，终止于 `2026-06-09`。\n\n该对齐策略合理但没有在规则文件中明文规定，必须在方法说明中披露。\n\n---\n\n# 12. drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = wealth.loc[trough:]\n    recovered = after[after >= wealth.loc[peak]]\n    recovery = recovered.index[0] if len(recovered) else None\n    return float(-dd.min()), peak, trough, recovery\n\n\ndef risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    es95 = float(losses[losses >= var95].mean())\n    es99 = float(losses[losses >= var99].mean())\n    r10 = (1 + r).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    loss10 = -r10.dropna()\n    var10 = float(np.quantile(loss10, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    worst_end = loss10.idxmax()\n    end_pos = r.index.get_loc(worst_end)\n    worst_start = r.index[end_pos - 9]\n    mdd, peak, trough, recovery = drawdown_details(r)\n    return {\n        \"ann_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(ANNUAL_DAYS)), \"var95\": var95, \"var99\": var99,\n        \"es95\": es95, \"es99\": es99, \"var10_99\": var10, \"worst10\": float(loss10.max()),\n        \"worst10_start\": worst_start, \"worst10_end\": worst_end, \"mdd\": mdd, \"dd_peak\": peak,\n        \"dd_trough\": compound(eq_internal.reindex(dates)), compound(market[\"spx_usd_ret\"].reindex(dates)),\n        compound(market[\"fx_ret\"].reindex(dates)),\n        *[market[\"yield_diff\"].reindex(dates)[t].sum() for t in TENORS],\n    ], dtype=float)\n\n\ndef historical_calibration(months, plans, market, eq_internal, sse):\n    records = []\n    calibrations = {}\n    all_windows = {}\n    ret =           if len(eligible) == 0:\n                    continue\n                start = eligible[0]\n                loc = sse.get_indexer([start])[0]\n                dates = sse[loc:loc + 10]\n                if len(dates) != 10 or dates[-1] > common_end or not pd.DatetimeIndex(dates).isin(pr.index).all():\n                    continue\n                port_ret = compound(pr.reindex(dates))\n                if port_ret < 0:\n                    windows.append({\"month\": month, \"start\": dates[0], \"end\": dates[-1], \"port_ret\": port_ret, \"factor\": factor_window(market, eq_internal, all_windows\n\n\ndef parse_cgb_shocks(text):\n    pairs = re.findall(r\"(1Y|2Y|5Y|10Y|30Y):([+-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\", str(text))\n    out = dict(pairs)\n    assert set(out) == set(TENORS)\n    return np.array([float(out[t]) for t in TENORS])\n\n\ndef stress_contributions(w, shock, duration):\n    eq, spx_usd, fx = shock[:3]\n    dy = shock[3:]\n    cn = float(w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum() * eq)\n    spx = float(w[\"SPX\"] * ((1 + spx_usd) * (1 + fx) - 1))\n    usd = float(w[\"USD_CASH\"] * fx)\n    bond = float(w[\"CGB\"] * (-(duration.to_numpy() * dy / 100.0).sum()))\n    total = cn + spx + usd + bond\n    assert np.isclose(cn + spx + usd + bond, total, atol=1e-13)\n    return cn, spx, usd, bond, total\n\n\ndef run_stress(inp, plans, calibrations, evaluate_constraints(inp, plans, metrics, stress):\n    limits = read_csv(inp / \"params_limits.csv\", dates=False).set_index(\"id\")\n    rows = []\n    for pname, w in plans.items():\n        values = {\n            \"L1\": w.sum(), \"L2\": w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n            \"L3\": w.CNY_CASH, \"L4\": w.CGB, \"L5\": w.USD_CASH + w.SPX,\n            \"L6\": metrics[pname][\"es99\"], \"L7\": metrics[pname][\"var10_99\"],\n            \"L8\": stress.loc[stress.方案 == pname, \"压力损失\"].max(),\n            \"L9\": stress.loc[stress.方案 == pname, \"压力损失\"].max(),\n        }\n        for lid, value in values.items():\n            r = limits.loc[lid]\n            op = r.op\n            lo = None if pd.isna(r.lower) else float(r.lower)\n            hi = None if pd.isna(r.upper) else float(r.upper)\n            if lid == \"L1\":\n                excess = max(abs(value - 1.0) - 0.0005, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = \"100.00%（容差±0.05个百分点）\"\n            elif op == \"<=\":\n                threshold_value = hi if hi is not None else lo\n                excess = max(value - threshold_value, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"≤{fmt_pct(threshold_value)}\"\n            elif op == \">=\":\n                threshold_value = lo if lo is not None else hi\n                excess = max(threshold_value - value, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"≥{fmt_pct(threshold_value)}\"\n            elif op == \"in\":\n                excess = max((lo - value) if value < lo else (value - hi) if value > hi else 0.0, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"{fmt_pct(lo)}~{fmt_pct(hi)}\"\n            else:\n                raise ValueError(f\"未知约束操作符 {op}\")\n            rows.append({\n                \"方案\": pname, \"约束\": lid, \"指标\": r.constraint, \"实际值\": fmt_pct(value),\n                \"阈值\": threshold, \"结论\": \"通过\" if passed else \"未通过\",\n                \"超限幅度\": \"0.00个百分点\" if passed else fmt_pp(excess),\n            })\n    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n    assert len(out) == 36\n    return out\n\n\ndef rolling_factor_vectors(market, eq_internal):\n    idx = market[\"returns\"].index\n    out = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)\n    out[\"境内权益\"] = (1 + eq_internal.reindex(idx)).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    out[\"SPX美元\"] = (1 + market[\"spx_usd_ret\"]).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    out[\"USD/CNH\"] = (1 + portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration):\n    return float(\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum() * x[0]\n        + w.SPX * ((1 + x[1]) * (1 + x[2]) - 1)\n        + w.USD_CASH * x[2]\n        - w.CGB * np.dot(duration.to_numpy(), x[3:]) / 100.0\n    )\n\n\ndef portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration):\n    return np.r_[\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n487\t    ].astype(float)\n488\t\n489\t\n490\tdef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n491\t    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n492\t    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n493\t    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n494\t    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n495\t    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n496\t    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n497\t    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n498\t    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n499\t    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n500\t    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n501\t    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n502\t    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n503\t    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n504\t    converged = False\n505\t    for _ in range(100):\n506\t        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n507\t        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n508\t        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n509\t            converged = True\n510\t            break\n511\t        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n512\t        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n513\t        x += step[:8]\n514\t        lam += step[8]\n515\t    if not converged:\n516\t        for _ in range(200):\n517\t            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n518\t            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n519\t                converged = True\n520\t                break\n521\t            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n522\t            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n523\t            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n524\t    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n525\t    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n526\t    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n527\t\n528\t\n529\tdef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n530\t    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n531\t    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n532\t\n533\t\n534\tdef evaluate_constraints(inp, plans, metrics, stress):\n    limits = read_csv(inp / \"params_limits.csv\", dates=False).set_index(\"id\")\n    rows = []\n    for pname, w in plans.items():\n        values = {\n            \"L1\": w.sum(), \"L2\": w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n            \"L3\": w.CNY_CASH, \"L4\": w.CGB, \"L5\": w.USD_CASH + w.SPX,\n            \"L6\": \"压力损失\"].max(),\n        }\n        for lid, value in values.items():\n            r = limits.loc[lid]\n            op = r.op\n            lo = None if pd.isna(r.lower) else float(r.lower)\n            hi = None if pd.isna(r.upper) else float(r.upper)\n            if lid == \"L1\":\n                excess = max(abs(value - 1.0) - 0.0005, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = \"100.00%（容差±0.05个百分点）\"\n            elif op == \"<=\":\n                threshold_value = hi if hi is not None else lo\n                excess = max(value - threshold_value, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"≤{fmt_pct(threshold_value)}\"\n            elif op == \">=\":\n                threshold_value = lo if lo is not None else hi\n                excess = max(threshold_value - value, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"≥{fmt_pct(threshold_value)}\"\n            elif op == \"in\":\n                excess = max((lo - value) if value < lo else (value - hi) if value > hi else 0.0, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"{fmt_pct(lo)}~{fmt_pct(hi)}\"\n            else:\n                raise ValueError(f\"未知约束操作符 {op}\")\n            rows.append({\n                \"方案\": pname, \"约束\": lid, \"指标\": r.constraint, \"实际值\": fmt_pct(value),\n                \"阈值\": threshold, \"结论\": \"通过\" if passed else \"未通过\",\n                \"超限幅度\": \"0.00个百分点\" if passed else fmt_pp(excess),\n            })\n    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n    assert len(out) == 36\n    return out\n\n\ndef rolling_factor_vectors(market, eq_internal):\n    idx = market[\"returns\"].index\n    out = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)\n    out[\"境内权益\"] = (1 + portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration):\n    return float(\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum() * x[0]\n        + w.SPX * ((1 + x[1]) * (1 + x[2]) - 1)\n        + w.USD_CASH * x[2]\n        - w.CGB * np.dot(duration.to_numpy(), x[3:]) / 100.0\n    )\n\n\ndef portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration):\n    return np.r_[\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, evaluate_constraints(inp, plans, metrics, stress):\n    limits = read_csv(inp / \"params_limits.csv\", dates=False).set_index(\"id\")\n    rows = []\n    for pname, w in plans.items():\n        values portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration):\n    return float(\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum() * x[0]\n        + w.SPX * ((1 + x[1]) * (1 + x[2]) - 1)\n        + \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = wealth.loc[trough:]\n    recovered = after[after >= wealth.loc[peak]]\n    recovery = recovered.index[0] if len(recovered) else None\n    return float(-dd.min()), peak, trough, recovery\n\n\ndef risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    es95 = float(losses[losses >= var95].mean())\n    es99 = float(losses[losses >= var99].mean())\n    r10 = (1 + r).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    loss10 = -r10.dropna()\n    var10 = float(np.quantile(loss10, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    worst_end = loss10.idxmax()\n    end_pos = r.index.get_loc(worst_end)\n    worst_start = r.index[end_pos - 9]\n    mdd, peak, trough, recovery = drawdown_details(r)\n    return {\n        \"mean_daily\": float(r.mean()), \"daily_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1)),\n        \"ann_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(ANNUAL_DAYS)), \"var95\": var95, \"var99\": var99,\n        \"es95\": es95, \"es99\": es99, \"var10_99\": var10, \"worst10\": float(loss10.max()),\n        \"worst10_start\": worst_start, \"worst10_end\": worst_end, \"mdd\": mdd, \"dd_peak\": peak,\n        \"dd_trough\": trough, \"dd_recovery\": recovery, \"worst1\": float(losses.max()),\n        \"worst1_date\": evaluate_constraints(inp, plans, metrics, stress):\n    limits = read_csv(inp / \"params_limits.csv\", dates=False).set_index(\"id\")\n    rows = []\n    for pname, w in plans.items():\n        values = {\n            \"L1\": w.sum(), \"L2\": w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n            \"L3\": w.CNY_CASH, \"L4\": w.CGB, \"L5\": w.USD_CASH + w.SPX,\n            \"L6\": \"压力损失\"].max(),\n        }\n        for lid, value in values.items():\n            r = limits.loc[lid]\n            op = r.op\n            lo = None if pd.isna(r.lower) else float(r.lower)\n            hi = None if pd.isna(r.upper) else float(r.upper)\n            if lid == \"L1\":\n                excess = max(abs(value - 1.0) - 0.0005, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = \"100.00%（容差±0.05个百分点）\"\n            elif op == \"<=\":\n                threshold_value = hi if hi is not None else lo\n                excess = max(value - threshold_value, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"≤{fmt_pct(threshold_value)}\"\n            elif op == \">=\":\n                threshold_value = lo if lo is not None else hi\n                excess = max(threshold_value - value, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"≥{fmt_pct(threshold_value)}\"\n            elif op == \"in\":\n                excess = max((lo - value) if value < lo else (value - hi) if value > hi else 0.0, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"{fmt_pct(lo)}~{fmt_pct(hi)}\"\n            else:\n                raise ValueError(f\"未知约束操作符 {op}\")\n            rows.append({\n                \"方案\": pname, \"约束\": lid, \"指标\": r.constraint, \"实际值\": fmt_pct(value),\n                \"阈值\": threshold, \"结论\": \"通过\" if passed else \"未通过\",\n                \"超限幅度\": \"0.00个百分点\" if passed else fmt_pp(excess),\n            })\n    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n    assert len(out) == 36\n    return out\n\n\ndef rolling_factor_vectors(market, eq_internal):\n    idx = market[\"returns\"].index\n    out = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)\n    out[\"境内权益\"] = (1 + portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration):\n    return float(\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum() * x[0]\n        + w.SPX * ((1 + x[1]) * (1 + x[2]) - 1)\n        + w.USD_CASH * x[2]\n        - w.CGB * np.dot(duration.to_numpy(), x[3:]) / 100.0\n    )\n\n\ndef portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration):\n    return np.r_[\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = wealth.loc[trough:]\n    recovered = after[after >= wealth.loc[peak]]\n    recovery = recovered.index[0] if len(recovered) else None\n    return float(-dd.min()), peak, trough, recovery\n\n\ndef risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    es95 = float(losses[losses >= var95].mean())\n    es99 = float(losses[losses >= var99].mean())\n    r10 = (1 + r).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    loss10 = -r10.dropna()\n    var10 = float(np.quantile(loss10, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    worst_end = loss10.idxmax()\n    end_pos = r.index.get_loc(worst_end)\n    worst_start = r.index[end_pos - 9]\n    mdd, peak, trough, recovery = drawdown_details(r)\n    return {\n        \"mean_daily\": float(r.mean()), \"daily_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1)),\n        \"ann_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(ANNUAL_DAYS)), \"var95\": var95, \"var99\": var99,\n        \"es95\": es95, \"es99\": es99, \"var10_99\": var10, \"worst10\": float(loss10.max()),\n        \"worst10_start\": worst_start, \"worst10_end\": worst_end, \"mdd\": mdd, \"dd_peak\": peak,\n        \"dd_trough\": trough, \"dd_recovery\": recovery, \"worst1\": float(losses.max()),\n        \"worst1_date\": })\n    return pd.DataFrame(records), calibrations, all_windows\n\n\ndef parse_cgb_shocks(text):\n    pairs = re.findall(r\"(1Y|2Y|5Y|10Y|30Y):([+-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\", str(text))\n    out = \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = wealth.loc[trough:]\n    recovered = after[after >= wealth.loc[peak]]\n    recovery = recovered.index[0] if len(recovered) else None\n    return float(-dd.min()), peak, trough, recovery\n\n\ndef risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    es95 = float(losses[losses >= var95].mean())\n    es99 = float(losses[losses >= var99].mean())\n    r10 = (1 + r).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    loss10 = -r10.dropna()\n    var10 = float(np.quantile(loss10, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    worst_end = loss10.idxmax()\n    end_pos = r.index.get_loc(worst_end)\n    worst_start = r.index[end_pos - 9]\n    mdd, peak, trough, recovery = drawdown_details(r)\n    return {\n        \"mean_daily\": float(r.mean()), \"daily_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1)),\n        \"ann_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(ANNUAL_DAYS)), \"var95\": var95, \"var99\": var99,\n        \"es95\": es95, \"es99\": es99, \"var10_99\": var10, \"worst10\": float(loss10.max()),\n        \"worst10_start\": worst_start, \"worst10_end\": worst_end, \"mdd\": mdd, \"dd_peak\": peak,\n        \"dd_trough\": trough, \"dd_recovery\": recovery, \"worst1\": float(losses.max()),\n        \"worst1_date\": r.index[np.argmax(losses)],\n    }\n\n\ndef monthly_last_valid(df, col):\n    d = df.dropna(subset=[col]).copy()\n    d[\"month\"] = d.date.dt.to_period(\"M\")\n    return })\n    return pd.DataFrame(records), calibrations, all_windows\n\n\ndef parse_cgb_shocks(text):\n    pairs = re.findall(r\"(1Y|2Y|5Y|10Y|30Y):([+-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\", str(text))\n    out = pname, w in plans.items():\n        values = {\n            \"L1\": w.sum(), \"L2\": w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n            \"L3\": w.CNY_CASH, \"L4\": w.CGB, \"L5\": stress.loc[stress.方案 == pname, \"压力损失\"].max(),\n        }\n        for lid, value in values.items():\n            r = limits.loc[lid]\n            op = r.op\n            lo = None if pd.isna(r.lower) else float(r.lower)\n            hi = None if pd.isna(r.upper) else float(r.upper)\n            if lid == \"L1\":\n                excess = max(abs(value - 1.0) - 0.0005, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = \"100.00%（容差±0.05个百分点）\"\n            elif op == \"<=\":\n                threshold_value = hi if hi is not None else lo\n                excess = max(value - threshold_value, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"≤{fmt_pct(threshold_value)}\"\n            elif op == \">=\":\n                threshold_value = lo if lo out.dropna()\n\n\ndef portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration):\n    return float(\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum() * x[0]\n        + w.SPX * ((1 + x[1]) * (1 + x[2]) - 1)\n        + w.USD_CASH * x[2]\n        - w.CGB * np.dot(duration.to_numpy(), x[3:]) / 100.0\n    )\n\n\ndef portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration):\n    return np.r_[\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, pname, w in plans.items():\n        values = {\n            \"L1\": w.sum(), \"L2\": w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n            \"L3\": w.CNY_CASH, \"L4\": w.CGB, \"L5\": else float(r.lower)\n            hi = None if pd.isna(r.upper) else float(r.upper)\n            if lid == \"L1\":\n                excess = max(abs(value - 1.0) - 0.0005, 0.0)\n                passed \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, * turnover:.2f}万元，单向换手率=卖出合计/净值={fmt_pct(turnover)}。图4-b展示两种路径及8%现金下限。\n\n### risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, }\n\n\ndef plan_weights(inp):\n    candidates = read_csv(inp / \"plans_candidates.csv\", dates=False)\n    plans = {}\n    for _, r in candidates.iterrows():\n        plans[r.plan_id] = pd.Series({\n drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = wealth.loc[trough:]\n    recovered = after[after >= wealth.loc[peak]]\n    recovery = recovered.index[0] if len(recovered) else None\n    return float(-dd.min()), peak, trough, recovery\n\n\ndef risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    es95 = float(losses[losses >= var95].mean())\n    es99 = float(losses[losses >= var99].mean())\n    r10 = (1 + r).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    loss10 = -r10.dropna()\n    var10 = float(np.quantile(loss10, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    worst_end = loss10.idxmax()\n    end_pos = r.index.get_loc(worst_end)\n    worst_start = r.index[end_pos - 9]\n    mdd, peak, trough, recovery = drawdown_details(r)\n    return {\n        \"mean_daily\": float(r.mean()), \"daily_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1)),\n        \"ann_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(ANNUAL_DAYS)), \"var95\": var95, \"var99\": var99,\n        \"es95\": es95, \"es99\": es99, \"var10_99\": var10, \"worst10\": float(loss10.max()),\n        \"worst10_start\": worst_start, \"worst10_end\": worst_end, \"mdd\": mdd, \"dd_peak\": peak,\n        \"dd_trough\": trough, \"dd_recovery\": recovery, \"worst1\": float(losses.max()),\n        \"worst1_date\": r.index[np.argmax(losses)],\n    }\n\n\ndef monthly_last_valid(df, col):\n    d = df.dropna(subset=[col]).copy()\n    d[\"month\"] = d.date.dt.to_period(\"M\")\n    return *[market[\"yield_diff\"].reindex(dates)[t].sum() for t in TENORS],\n    ], dtype=float)\n\n\ndef historical_calibration(months, plans, market, eq_internal, sse):\n    records = []\n    calibrations = })\n    return pd.DataFrame(records), calibrations, all_windows\n\n\ndef parse_cgb_shocks(text):\n    pairs = re.findall(r\"(1Y|2Y|5Y|10Y|30Y):([+-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\", str(text))\n    out = pname, w in plans.items():\n        values = {\n            \"L1\": w.sum(), \"L2\": w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n            \"L3\": w.CNY_CASH, \"L4\": w.CGB, \"L5\": stress.loc[stress.方案 == pname, \"压力损失\"].max(),\n        }\n        for lid, value in values.items():\n            r = limits.loc[lid]\n            op = r.op\n            lo = None if pd.isna(r.lower) else float(r.lower)\n            hi = None if pd.isna(r.upper) else float(r.upper)\n            if lid == \"L1\":\n                excess = max(abs(value - 1.0) - 0.0005, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = \"100.00%（容差±0.05个百分点）\"\n            elif op == \"<=\":\n                threshold_value = hi if hi is not None else lo\n                excess = max(value - threshold_value, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"≤{fmt_pct(threshold_value)}\"\n            elif op == \">=\":\n                threshold_value = lo if lo is not None else hi\n                excess = max(threshold_value - value, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"≥{fmt_pct(threshold_value)}\"\n            elif op out.dropna()\n\n\ndef portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration):\n    return float(\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum() * x[0]\n        + w.SPX * ((1 + x[1]) * (1 + x[2]) - 1)\n        + w.USD_CASH * x[2]\n        - w.CGB * np.dot(duration.to_numpy(), x[3:]) / 100.0\n    )\n\n\ndef portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration):\n    return np.r_[\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = wealth.loc[trough:]\n    recovered = after[after >= wealth.loc[peak]]\n    recovery = recovered.index[0] if len(recovered) else None\n    return float(-dd.min()), peak, trough, recovery\n\n\ndef risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    es95 = float(losses[losses >= var95].mean())\n    es99 = float(losses[losses >= var99].mean())\n    r10 = (1 + r).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    loss10 = -r10.dropna()\n    var10 = float(np.quantile(loss10, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    worst_end = loss10.idxmax()\n    end_pos = r.index.get_loc(worst_end)\n    worst_start = r.index[end_pos - 9]\n    mdd, peak, trough, recovery = drawdown_details(r)\n    return {\n        \"mean_daily\": float(r.mean()), \"daily_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1)),\n        \"ann_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(ANNUAL_DAYS)), \"var95\": var95, \"var99\": var99,\n        \"es95\": es95, \"es99\": es99, \"var10_99\": var10, \"worst10\": float(loss10.max()),\n        \"worst10_start\": worst_start, \"worst10_end\": worst_end, \"mdd\": mdd, \"dd_peak\": peak,\n        \"dd_trough\": trough, \"dd_recovery\": recovery, \"worst1\": float(losses.max()),\n        \"worst1_date\": \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99,
