1)\n        + w.USD_CASH * x[2]\n        - w.CGB * np.dot(duration.to_numpy(), x[3:]) / 100.0\n    )\n\n\ndef portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration):\n    return np.r_[\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = wealth.loc[trough:]\n    recovered = after[after >= wealth.loc[peak]]\n    recovery = recovered.index[0] if len(recovered) else None\n    return float(-dd.min()), peak, trough, recovery\n\n\ndef risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    es95 = float(losses[losses >= var95].mean())\n    es99 = float(losses[losses >= var99].mean())\n    r10 = (1 + r).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    loss10 = -r10.dropna()\n    var10 = float(np.quantile(loss10, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    worst_end = loss10.idxmax()\n    end_pos = r.index.get_loc(worst_end)\n    worst_start = r.index[end_pos - 9]\n    mdd, peak, trough, recovery = drawdown_details(r)\n    return {\n        \"mean_daily\": float(r.mean()), \"daily_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1)),\n        \"ann_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(ANNUAL_DAYS)), \"var95\": var95, \"var99\": var99,\n        \"es95\": es95, \"es99\": es99, \"var10_99\": var10, \"worst10\": float(loss10.max()),\n        \"worst10_start\": worst_start, = excess == 0\n                threshold = \"100.00%（容差±0.05个百分点）\"\n            elif op == \"<=\":\n                threshold_value = hi if hi is not None else lo\n                excess = max(value is not None else hi\n                excess = max(threshold_value - value, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"≥{fmt_pct(threshold_value)}\"\n            elif op out[\"境内权益\"] = (1 + eq_internal.reindex(idx)).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    out[\"SPX美元\"] = (1 + market[\"spx_usd_ret\"]).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n out.dropna()\n\n\ndef portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration):\n    return float(\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum() * x[0]\n        + w.SPX * ((1 + x[1]) * (1 + x[2]) - 1)\n        + w.USD_CASH * x[2]\n        - w.CGB * np.dot(duration.to_numpy(), x[3:]) / 100.0\n    )\n\n\ndef portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration):\n    return np.r_[\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, *[market[\"yield_diff\"].reindex(dates)[t].sum() for t in TENORS],\n    ], dtype=float)\n\n\ndef historical_calibration(months, plans, market, eq_internal, sse):\n    records = []\n    calibrations = pname, w in plans.items():\n        values = {\n            \"L1\": w.sum(), \"L2\": w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n            \"L3\": w.CNY_CASH, \"L4\": w.CGB, \"L5\": else float(r.lower)\n            hi = None if pd.isna(r.upper) else float(r.upper)\n            if lid == \"L1\":\n                excess = max(abs(value - 1.0) - 0.0005, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = \"100.00%（容差±0.05个百分点）\"\n            elif op == \"<=\":\n                threshold_value = hi if hi is not None else lo\n                excess = max(value \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    stationarity = precision @ (x - mu) + lam * portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n    assert np.linalg.norm(stationarity) < 1e-7, \"反向压力解未满足KKT驻点条件\"\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    stationarity = precision @ (x - mu) + lam * portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n    assert np.linalg.norm(stationarity) < 1e-7, \"反向压力解未满足KKT驻点条件\"\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = wealth.loc[trough:]\n    recovered = after[after >= wealth.loc[peak]]\n    recovery = recovered.index[0] if len(recovered) else None\n    return float(-dd.min()), peak, trough, recovery\n\n\ndef risk_metrics(r):\n    r = pd.Series(r).dropna()\n    losses = -r.to_numpy()\n    var95 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.95, method=\"linear\"))\n    var99 = float(np.quantile(losses, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    es95 = float(losses[losses >= var95].mean())\n    es99 = float(losses[losses >= var99].mean())\n    r10 = (1 + r).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    loss10 = -r10.dropna()\n    var10 = float(np.quantile(loss10, 0.99, method=\"linear\"))\n    worst_end = loss10.idxmax()\n    end_pos = r.index.get_loc(worst_end)\n    worst_start = r.index[end_pos - 9]\n    mdd, peak, trough, recovery = drawdown_details(r)\n    return {\n        \"mean_daily\": float(r.mean()), \"daily_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1)),\n        \"ann_vol\": float(r.std(ddof=1) * })\n    return pd.DataFrame(records), calibrations, all_windows\n\n\ndef parse_cgb_shocks(text):\n    pairs = re.findall(r\"(1Y|2Y|5Y|10Y|30Y):([+-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\", str(text))\n    out = pname, w in plans.items():\n        values = {\n            \"L1\": w.sum(), \"L2\": w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n            \"L3\": w.CNY_CASH, \"L4\": w.CGB, \"L5\": else float(r.lower)\n            hi = None if pd.isna(r.upper) else float(r.upper)\n            if lid == \"L1\":\n                excess = max(abs(value - 1.0) - 0.0005, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = \"100.00%（容差±0.05个百分点）\"\n            elif op == \"<=\":\n                threshold_value = hi if hi is not None else lo\n                excess = max(value - threshold_value, 0.0)\n                passed = excess == 0\n                threshold = f\"≤{fmt_pct(threshold_value)}\"\n            elif op == \">=\":\n                threshold_value = lo if lo out[\"境内权益\"] = (1 + eq_internal.reindex(idx)).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n    out[\"SPX美元\"] = (1 + market[\"spx_usd_ret\"]).rolling(10).apply(np.prod, raw=True) - 1\n out.dropna()\n\n\ndef portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration):\n    return float(\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum() * x[0]\n        + w.SPX * ((1 + x[1]) * (1 + x[2]) - 1)\n        + w.USD_CASH * x[2]\n        - w.CGB * np.dot(duration.to_numpy(), x[3:]) / 100.0\n    )\n\n\ndef portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration):\n    return np.r_[\n        w[[\"EQ_000300\", \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    stationarity = precision @ (x - mu) + lam * portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n    assert np.linalg.norm(stationarity) < 1e-7, \"反向压力解未满足KKT驻点条件\"\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef mahalanobis(x, mu, precision):\n    d = np.asarray(x) - mu\n    return float(np.sqrt(max(d @ precision @ d, 0)))\n\n\ndef compute_monitors(loaded, market, sse):\n    rows = []\n    eq = else float(r.lower)\n            hi = None if pd.isna(r.upper) else float(r.upper)\n            if lid == \"L1\":\n                excess = max(abs(value - 1.0) - 0.0005, 0.0)\n                passed \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    stationarity = precision @ (x - mu) + lam * portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n    assert np.linalg.norm(stationarity) < 1e-7, \"反向压力解未满足KKT驻点条件\"\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = else float(r.lower)\n            hi = None if pd.isna(r.upper) else float(r.upper)\n            if lid == \"L1\":\n                excess = max(abs(value - 1.0) - 0.0005, 0.0)\n                passed \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    stationarity = precision @ (x - mu) + lam * portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n    assert np.linalg.norm(stationarity) < 1e-7, \"反向压力解未满足KKT驻点条件\"\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef * turnover:.2f}万元，单向换手率=卖出合计/净值={fmt_pct(turnover)}。图4-b展示两种路径及8%现金下限。\n\n### drawdown_details(r):\n    wealth = (1 + r).cumprod()\n    peaks = wealth.cummax()\n    dd = wealth / peaks - 1\n    trough = dd.idxmin()\n    peak = wealth.loc[:trough].idxmax()\n    after = \"EQ_000905\", \"EQ_399006\"]].sum(),\n        w.SPX * (1 + x[2]), w.SPX * (1 + x[1]) + w.USD_CASH,\n        -w.CGB * duration.to_numpy() / 100.0,\n    ].astype(float)\n\n\ndef reverse_stress(factors, w, duration, target_loss=0.08):\n    mu = factors.mean().to_numpy()\n    cov = factors.cov().to_numpy()\n    cov = (cov + cov.T) / 2\n    eig, vec = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\n    floor = max(eig.max() * 1e-10, 1e-14)\n    cov_reg = (vec * np.maximum(eig, floor)) @ vec.T\n    precision = np.linalg.inv(cov_reg)\n    grad0 = portfolio_gradient(mu, w, duration)\n    g0 = portfolio_factor_return(mu, w, duration) + target_loss\n    lam = g0 / float(grad0 @ cov_reg @ grad0)\n    x = mu - lam * (cov_reg @ grad0)\n    hess = np.zeros((8, 8))\n    hess[1, 2] = hess[2, 1] = w.SPX\n    converged = False\n    for _ in range(100):\n        grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n        f = np.r_[precision @ (x - mu) + lam * grad, portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss]\n        if np.linalg.norm(f) < 1e-10:\n            converged = True\n            break\n        jac = np.block([[precision + lam * hess, grad[:, None]], [grad[None, :], np.zeros((1, 1))]])\n        step = np.linalg.solve(jac, -f)\n        x += step[:8]\n        lam += step[8]\n    if not converged:\n        for _ in range(200):\n            g = portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss\n            if abs(g) < 1e-11:\n                converged = True\n                break\n            grad = portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n            denom = float(grad @ cov_reg @ grad)\n            x -= g * (cov_reg @ grad) / denom\n    assert converged and abs(portfolio_factor_return(x, w, duration) + target_loss) < 1e-8\n    stationarity = precision @ (x - mu) + lam * portfolio_gradient(x, w, duration)\n    assert np.linalg.norm(stationarity) < 1e-7, \"反向压力解未满足KKT驻点条件\"\n    distance = float(np.sqrt((x - mu) @ precision @ (x - mu)))\n    return x, distance, mu, cov_reg, precision\n\n\ndef
